title: Amluk-Dara Stupa
subtitle: Buddhist stupa south of the Swat River, near Barikot, Lower Swat

landmark.name: Amluk-Dara Stupa
edits: The stupa is the Atlas maquette (a procedural model, not a survey). Published (Wikipedia): a square plinth about 4 m thick (read here as its height) and a hemispherical dome 7 m high and 21 m across. The 34 m square plinth width is NOT in that source: the maquette note cites a heritage source for it, which was not checked here, so it is unverified. The drum, the stair on the east side and the plinth profile are estimated.
The ground is levelled to a 30 m terrace round the stupa so the plinth sits flat; the surrounding slope is the real DEM.
The walk from the road to the stupa has no mapped footpath: it is the easiest route over the DEM.
Rubble and wall stubs around the plinth are drawn after Commons photos; their positions are illustrative.

sources.name: Amluk-Dara Stupa maquette (Tiny Atlas, procedural)
sources.use: the stupa's plinth, drum and dome; the 21 m diameter and the 4 m plinth follow the published figures (Wikipedia); the 34 m plinth width is unverified and the other proportions are estimated

osm_use: the village road (unclassified, 4.5 km) that passes 170 m east of the stupa, and the stupa point (tourism=attraction)
